name: cached-declaration-e2e-oracle-scope
body: Limits: the export oracle scopes out the language-scaffolding records (the bare language root and Contains edges incident to it), because the reuse spool carries no module records so the assembly lacks a Language node while the no-reuse reference materialises one from a Record::Module — upgrade to a strict full-export comparison when the reuse assembly replays the language root on the spawned path; and the Module arm exercises pass 2, not pass 2b (skipped_langs empty) — add a skipped-language fixture if pass 2b's planned-aware guard ever needs direct pinning.
